Subject: Annual lockbox setup + country VAT routing (next steps)

Maria —

Thanks again for the call this morning. To get the annual committed spend drawdown and invoice flow set up for Brightlane, here's what we need to land this week so billing ops can automate the lockbox and VAT tagging: 

- Final invoice cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and the exact invoice numbering pattern you want on remittance.
- Bank lockbox details (receiving bank, account number for the lockbox, and an AP contact).
- Country VAT proof for Brightlane entities (we need certificates for EU countries where you claim VAT registration).
- Any specific PO/GL codes you want us to write on invoices for your ledger.

I've attached a draft invoice schedule (Brightlane_Invoice_Schedule_Q3-2027.xlsx) that maps committed amounts to monthly drawdown buckets — please review and mark any changes. Once we have confirmation we will:

1) Generate a lockbox agreement for signatures;
2) Push the bill schedule to our collections queue and set up ledger tags (Kim will own the mapping);
3) Configure VAT routing per country in our billing system and send you the first autogenerated invoice for April.

Can you reply with the bank/lockbox details and upload the VAT certificates? If you prefer, send via the ops inbox (ops@brightlane.ai) and cc me.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Brightlane_Invoice_Schedule_Q3-2027.xlsx

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the summary and the schedule — the spreadsheet looks fine at a high level. Quick answers below: 

- Invoice cadence: monthly drawdowns (we prefer ISO month-end dates).
- Invoice numbering: Please use BL-INV-YYYYMM-001 pattern (we will reconcile on our side).
- Lockbox bank: FirstNational Bank — Account: 4567890123 (Lockbox Operations). AP contact: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@brightlane.ai>.
- VAT evidence: attaching Brightlane-VAT-Certificate.pdf for our EU entity (this covers DE/FR/IE). We'll upload the rest to the ops inbox by EOD.
- PO codes: our GL team asked for 'BR-LN-DEV' to appear in the invoice memo field.

I've attached the VAT certificate and a signed MOP (signed-mop.pdf) for your records. We can sign the lockbox agreement as soon as you send it.

Appreciate it — I copied our ops alias so they can coordinate the file drops.

—Maria
Head of Finance, Brightlane Analytics

Maria —

Great, thanks for the fast turnaround and for the files. Two quick clarifications before we finalize the lockbox agreement: 

1) Month-end cadence: we'll set invoice generation for the 1st business day after month-end and route payments hitting the lockbox the same day to your account. Is that acceptable?
2) Invoice numbering: we'll adopt BL-INV-YYYYMM-001 and start numbering for May 2027 as BL-INV-202705-001. Please confirm if you need the invoice PDFs to include both the PO code and a separate 'project' field for internal routing.

Kim — can you confirm GL tag mapping and whether VAT routing needs an additional tax rate override per country? 

David — if legal is happy with the bank account structure we'll share the lockbox-draft-agreement.pdf for signatures (I put a placeholder for the sweep frequency).

Best,
Naomi
